description: '''Electro house''' is a [[music genre|genre]] of [[electronic dance music]] and a subgenre of [[house music]] characterized by heavy [[Bass (sound)|bass,]] prominent melodic riffs and a [[tempo]] around 125–135 beats per minute. The term has been used to describe the music of many [[DJ Mag Top 100 DJs|''DJ Mag'' Top 100 DJs]], including [[David Guetta]], [[Benny Benassi]], [[Skrillex]], [[Steve Aoki]], [[Porter Robinson]] and [[Deadmau5]]. It is generally described in terms that contrast its energy, melody and appeal to party crowds with more restrained and serious tech house and minimal techno which it is closely related to.
